speaker: god
text: Though they are allied and numerous, yet they will be cut down and pass away. Though I have afflicted you, O Judah, I will afflict you no longer.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For I will now break their yoke from your neck and tear away your shackles.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: There will be no descendants to carry on your name. I will cut off the carved image and cast idol from the house of your gods; I will prepare your grave, for you are contemptible.
name: The LORD

speaker: invaders
text: Plunder the silver! Plunder the gold!
name: The invaders

speaker: god
text: I will send your chariots up in smoke, and the sword will devour your young lions. I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voices of your messengers will no longer be heard.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will lift your skirts over your face. I will show your nakedness to the nations and your shame to the kingdoms.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will pelt you with filth and treat you with contempt; I will make a spectacle of you.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Then all who see you will recoil from you and say, ‘Nineveh is devastated; who will grieve for her?’ Where can I find comforters for you?
name: The LORD
